 Longswords are a type of versatile martial melee weapon. The following are some base attributes common to most longswords, although special or magical variants may be significantly different. For the most common, nonmagical type of this weapon, see Longsword. Further down below, you can find a list of all longswords in the game.

Properties

One-handed damage
1d8 (1~8) + Strength modifier ⁠Slashing
Two-handed damage
1d10 (1~10) + Strength modifier ⁠Slashing
Details
 Versatile
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Dippable

Actions

If you have proficiency, equip in main hand to gain:

 Lacerate ()
Slash at your target's vital points to make it  Bleed. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
 Rush Attack ()
Charge forward and attack the first enemy in your way, possibly pushing them  Off Balance. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
 Pommel Strike ()
Make a non-lethal attack against an enemy and possibly  Daze them. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
